_about: I'm Upping My P(doom) - frame-accurate analysis. All times in seconds from the first decoded PCM sample of assets/pdoom.mp3 (ffmpeg/librosa/WebAudio decodeAudioData convention; the MP3 has a 23 ms encoder-delay start_time that some players/containers apply - verify once with a click test). See analysis/REPORT.md.

grid.formula: beat k (0-based) = t0 + k*beat_period; bar n (1-based) starts at t0 + (n-1)*bar_period

sections.name: intro
sections.desc: Soft synth pad/keys only (no drums). Vocal breath/hum pickup from 1.60 s; high-band swell 1.2-2.05 s into bar 2.

sections.name: verse1
sections.desc: Vocals over 8th-note synth plucks, NO drums. 'I see sparks of AGI...' through '...you're my boss'.

sections.name: prechorus1

drums.kick: every beat from 16.60; 16th roll bar 13 beats 1-2; none during stop

sections.desc: Noise riser 16.1-16.6 then four-on-the-floor kick enters on bar 10 (16.60) with crash; 'ChatGPT, please don't eat me alive'. Bar 13 beats 1-2: 16th-note kick roll; beats 3-4 (22.98-23.85): full instrumental STOP while 'I'm upping my P-' is sung.

sections.name: chorus1
sections.desc: DROP on 'DOOM' at 23.87 (bar 14 downbeat). Kick on every beat + clap on 2 & 4 + open hat on off-beat 8ths. Vocal lines end 35.5; wordless vocal fills 35.7-37.2; drum fill end of bar 21.

sections.name: verse2
sections.desc: Full groove continues (kick/clap/hats), vocals 'We had a stable training run...' to '...atoms rearranging'.

sections.name: prechorus2

drums.kick: every beat; 8ths in bar 32; 16th roll bar 33 beats 1-2; none during stop

sections.desc: Lighter: kick without clap, long notes 'Sydney, please let me free'. Bar 32 kick on 8ths + riser (build); bar 33 beats 1-2 kick roll; beats 3-4 (59.35-60.22) STOP with 'I'm upping my P-' pickup.

sections.name: chorus2
sections.desc: DROP on 'DOOM' at 60.24 (bar 34). Basilisk / NVDA / Omega Point / 1e30 FLOPs / 'safe enough'. Wordless ad-libs 68.2-69.5 and 71.8-73.8. Drum fill end of bar 41; verse-3 pickup 'Forward' at 74.10.

sections.name: verse3
sections.desc: Full groove. 'Forward MLP...' / von Neumann / sharp left turn / CDR. Bar 49 ends with kick 8ths fill.

sections.name: breakdown
sections.desc: Drums OUT (instrumental ~-32 dB): pad + long vocal notes 'Gato, please don't let me go'. Big riser 95.0-96.6. Hook pickup 'I'm upping my P-' at 95.43.

sections.name: chorus3_halftime
sections.desc: Half-time breakdown chorus (lowest energy of the song, instrumental -30..-41 dB): kick only on beat 1 of bars 54/56/58/60, noise-claps, reverse swells into bars 58 and 60. Paperclips / killswitch / fuse / orthogonality lines; 'blues' melisma + wordless vocal 108.4-109.8.

sections.name: verse4_bridge
sections.desc: Full groove returns at 109.33. 'Just (just) transformers all the way' / disobey / Chinchilla / safety fence / 100k GPU / RLHF.

sections.name: chorus4_final
sections.desc: No stop: the hook is sung in augmented quarter notes starting 123.66 and 'DOOM' lands on bar 70 (125.69). Loom / masked pre-training / recursive self-upgrade / 'What did Ilya see? We'll never know' (held to 136.6).

sections.name: stop
sections.desc: Whole-bar instrumental drop-out 138.45-140.24 (inst ~-60 dB): 'Was it all for show?' ('all' 138.41 on the cut, 'show' 140.04).

sections.name: outro_drop
sections.desc: Final DROP at 140.24: loudest section, full groove + pitched vocal-chop/lead stabs on every beat (non-lexical).

sections.name: ending
sections.desc: Final kick 152.96 then sustained chord (bar 85) and fade from 154.8; -50 dB at 155.85, silence by 156.5.

lines.text: I see sparks of AGI in your eyes
lines.note: Vocal breath/hum from 1.60 s; first lexical word 'I' on the bar-2 downbeat (2.05). Show the line from ~1.6.

lines.text: There was a sudden drop in your training loss,
now I'm your servant and you're my boss
ChatGPT, please don't eat me alive
lines.note: Burned-in subtitle is 1.3 s late: 'Chat-' starts on the bar-10 downbeat together with the kick entry.
Chorus hook. Sung into the 22.98-23.85 instrumental stop; DOOM = drop at 23.871.
'lies' held to 31.8; unlabelled vocal notes 31.85-33.2 (backing 'ooh'/echo - subtitle keeps the line up to 33.4).

lines.text: We had a stable training run,

lines.note: 'Syd-ney' is a 2.9 s melisma (53.02-55.9); subtitle starts 0.38 s late.
Chorus hook; stop 59.35-60.22; DOOM = drop at 60.235.
NVDA sung as letters N-V-D-A on 8th notes (ASR hears 'in the E-eight'); subtitle 0.5 s late.

lines.text: One E thirty flops a second
That was safe enough, we reckoned
lines.note: 'reckoned' ends 71.75; wordless ad-libs 71.8-73.8 are not in the lyric sheet.
Subtitle is 1.1 s early: 'Forward' starts at 74.10 (pickup into bar 42).

lines.text: Sharp left turn and there you are
Gato, please don't let me go
lines.note: Breakdown; long notes. 'Gato' on the bar-50 downbeat (89.33) as the drums drop out.
Chorus hook over the riser; DOOM = bar 54 downbeat 96.598.

lines.text: Now there's nowhere left to go.
Too late now, we lit the fuse.

lines.note: 'blues' held/melisma to ~108.3; more wordless vocal 108.4-109.8 (both ASR models hear 'who's a...', possibly an echo of 'Ortho-': unverified).
Both CTC models hear the word 'just' repeated 2-3x (110.2, 110.7, ~111.1) before 'transformers' (111.2-111.4); subtitle 0.8 s early.
Final chorus: hook in quarter notes, no stop; DOOM on bar 70 downbeat 125.689.

lines.text: What did Ilya see? We'll never know.

lines.note: 'Was' is a pickup (137.40); the instrumental cuts out at 138.45 on 'all'; 'show' at 140.04 rings into the outro drop at 140.235.

hooks.rhythm: 8th notes; I'm = drop - 2.5 beats; last 5 syllables sung into the instrumental stop, DOOM on the drop downbeat
identical to chorus 1 ('my' has no detectable onset: grid value)
identical, over the breakdown riser (no stop); 'my' = grid value
AUGMENTED: quarter notes (~0.46 s apart), no stop; 'P' -> 'DOOM' still a half beat. Lowest confidence of the four (+-0.1 s on I'm/up)

vocal_extra.what: outro: pitched vocal-chop (or lead) stabs on every beat, non-lexical

energy_info.definition: EBU R128 momentary loudness (400 ms, K-weighted) of the full mix mapped linearly from -45.0 LUFS -> 0 to the song max -12.1 LUFS -> 1
